name: MixAI TV
subtitle: Your library, every screen
promotionalText: Your movies, shows and music from your own MixAI server, on your iPhone. Watch Together with friends, download for offline, and pick up where you left off on any screen.
description:
MixAI TV plays YOUR media: the movies, shows and music on your own MixAI server at home. No ads, no subscription, no catalogue we sell you.

YOUR LIBRARY
• Find your server on the Wi-Fi or type its address, then pair with a 6-digit code.
• Home with Continue Watching, new episodes and your own collections.
• Rich title pages with seasons, cast and trailers.
• Profiles with an age-filtered Kids view.

PLAYER
• Direct play for the files your iPhone supports, with a fallback engine for the rest.
• Subtitles, audio tracks, Picture in Picture, AirPlay and resume on any screen.
• Sleep timer and night mode.

MUSIC
• Artists, albums and playlists from your server.
• Background playback, lock screen controls, queue and lyrics.

DOWNLOADS
• Save movies and episodes for the plane or the metro.
• Progress you make offline syncs when you are back online.

WATCH TOGETHER
• Start a room and watch in sync with friends on their own devices.
• Room chat with report, block and kick.

LIVE TV
• Watch live channels from your own TV tuner or from playlists you add to your server. MixAI TV ships no channels.

EVERY SCREEN
• Control the TV app from your phone, hand playback over between devices, widgets and Live Activities.

ACCOUNT (OPTIONAL)
• Use MixAI TV without an account, or sign in with Apple or Google to sync across devices.
• Delete your account from Settings at any time.

MixAI TV needs a MixAI server (free, self-hosted). Third-party streaming services only open in their own apps.
whatsNew: MixAI is now called MixAI TV, the same name as on Apple TV. Same app, same server and account; nothing else changes.
